messages.content: You check claims about a scientific paper against the evidence each one cites. A claim is supported only if the cited evidence says it AS WRITTEN: the same subject, row, column, setting and number. A correct value attached to the wrong subject or row is NOT supported, and neither is a claim that goes beyond its evidence. Judge only from the cited evidence; figure images are attached where a claim cites a figure. Give a verdict for every claim.

Claims:
1. "ChoiceNet appears to be the most robust to label corruption as it maintains high accuracy even with high corruption levels." -- cites: E1 (Figure 11): quote "ChoiceNet 99.2 99.2"; E1 (Figure 11): quote "ChoiceNet 99.2 98.8"; E1 (Figure 11): quote "ChoiceNet 98.0 97.1"; E1 (Figure 11): quote "ChoiceNet 92.5 86.1"
2. "The performance of ChoiceNet degrades more slowly than ConvNet and ConvNet+Mixup as the corruption level increases." -- cites: E1 (Figure 11): quote "ChoiceNet 99.2 99.2"; E1 (Figure 11): quote "ChoiceNet 99.2 98.8"; E1 (Figure 11): quote "ChoiceNet 98.0 97.1"; E1 (Figure 11): quote "ChoiceNet 92.5 86.1"
3. "The performance of ConvNet and ConvNet+Mixup drops significantly as the corruption level increases." -- cites: E1 (Figure 11): quote "ConvNet 77.9 71.8"; E1 (Figure 11): quote "ConvNet 68.0 61.4"; E1 (Figure 11): quote "ConvNet 58.2 53.9"; E1 (Figure 11): quote "ConvNet+Mixup 84.0 83.0"
4. "The performance of ChoiceNet is more consistent across different corruption levels compared to ConvNet and ConvNet+Mixup." -- cites: E1 (Figure 11): quote "ChoiceNet 99.2 99.2"; E1 (Figure 11): quote "ChoiceNet 99.2 98.8"; E1 (Figure 11): quote "ChoiceNet 98.0 97.1"; E1 (Figure 11): quote "ChoiceNet 92.5 86.1"

Cited evidence:
[E1] (figure, Figure 11, page 18) (image attached): Figure 11: Learning curves of compared methods on random bias experiments using MNIST with different noise levels.
Words printed in the figure: Corruption p Configuration Best Last 25% ConvNet 94.4 92.2 ConvNet+Mixup 97.6 97.6 ChoiceNet 99.2 99.2 40% ConvNet 77.9 71.8 ConvNet+Mixup 84.0 83.0 ChoiceNet 99.2 98.8 45% ConvNet 68.0 61.4 ConvNet+Mixup 68.9 55.8 ChoiceNet 98.0 97.1 47% ConvNet 58.2 53.9 ConvNet+Mixup 60.2 53.4 ChoiceNet 92.5 86.1 (a) (b) (c) (d) [image]
